\section[(dialogue)]{Nature, animals and the body — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R132-first-pass-nature-animals-and-the-body}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for strong and weak.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a sandal, a button, a tie, gloves, a hill
  \item a stream, earth, grass, a seed, a root
  \item a branch, a rock, a waterfall, a pond, a well
  \item a storm, the ground, a coast, an island, a sparrow
  \item a crow, a peacock, a butterfly, an ant, a donkey
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A sandal? (\textbf{\ur{چپل}}, \emph{chappal}.) A button? (\textbf{\ur{بٹن}}, \emph{baṭan}.) A tie? (\textbf{\ur{ٹائی}}, \emph{ṭāī}.) Gloves? (\textbf{\ur{دستانے}}, \emph{dastāne}.) A hill? (\textbf{\ur{پہاڑی}}, \emph{pahāṛī}.) A stream? (\textbf{\ur{ندی}}, \emph{nadī}.) Earth? (\textbf{\ur{مٹی}}, \emph{miṭṭī}.) Grass? (\textbf{\ur{گھاس}}, \emph{ghās}.) A seed? (\textbf{\ur{بیج}}, \emph{bīj}.) A root? (\textbf{\ur{جڑ}}, \emph{jaṛ}.) A branch? (\textbf{\ur{شاخ}}, \emph{shākh}.) A rock? (\textbf{\ur{چٹان}}, \emph{chaṭṭān}.) A waterfall? (\textbf{\ur{جھرنا}}, \emph{jharnā}.) A pond? (\textbf{\ur{تالاب}}, \emph{tālāb}.) A well? (\textbf{\ur{کنواں}}, \emph{kuāṅ}.) A storm? (\textbf{\ur{آندھی}}, \emph{āṅdhī}.) The ground? (\textbf{\ur{زمین}}, \emph{zamīn}.) A coast? (\textbf{\ur{ساحل}}, \emph{sāhil}.) An island? (\textbf{\ur{جزیرہ}}, \emph{jazīrā}.) A sparrow? (\textbf{\ur{چڑیا}}, \emph{chiṛyā}.) A crow? (\textbf{\ur{کوا}}, \emph{kavvā}.) A peacock? (\textbf{\ur{مور}}, \emph{mor}.) A butterfly? (\textbf{\ur{تتلی}}, \emph{titlī}.) An ant? (\textbf{\ur{چیونٹی}}, \emph{chyūṅṭī}.) A donkey? (\textbf{\ur{گدھا}}, \emph{gadhā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{The body and describing words — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R132-second-pass-the-body-and-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a camel and a fox.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a camel, a fox, a mosquito, a fly, a rabbit
  \item a deer, a pigeon, a parrot, a bear, the waist
  \item the back, the forehead, a cheek, the chin, a wrist
  \item an elbow, a thumb, a nail, the skin, the chest
  \item bitter, sour, salty, fast, slow
  \item dirty, rich, true; the truth, strong, weak
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A camel? (\textbf{\ur{اونٹ}}, \emph{ūṅṭ}.) A fox? (\textbf{\ur{لومڑی}}, \emph{lomṛī}.) A mosquito? (\textbf{\ur{مچھر}}, \emph{machchhar}.) A fly? (\textbf{\ur{مکھی}}, \emph{makkhī}.) A rabbit? (\textbf{\ur{خرگوش}}, \emph{khargosh}.) A deer? (\textbf{\ur{ہرن}}, \emph{hiran}.) A pigeon? (\textbf{\ur{کبوتر}}, \emph{kabūtar}.) A parrot? (\textbf{\ur{طوطا}}, \emph{totā}.) A bear? (\textbf{\ur{بھالو}}, \emph{bhālū}.) The waist? (\textbf{\ur{کمر}}, \emph{kamar}.) The back? (\textbf{\ur{پیٹھ}}, \emph{pīṭh}.) The forehead? (\textbf{\ur{ماتھا}}, \emph{māthā}.) A cheek? (\textbf{\ur{گال}}, \emph{gāl}.) The chin? (\textbf{\ur{ٹھوڑی}}, \emph{ṭhoṛī}.) A wrist? (\textbf{\ur{کلائی}}, \emph{kalāī}.) An elbow? (\textbf{\ur{کہنی}}, \emph{kohnī}.) A thumb? (\textbf{\ur{انگوٹھا}}, \emph{angūṭhā}.) A nail? (\textbf{\ur{ناخن}}, \emph{nākhun}.) The skin? (\textbf{\ur{جلد}}, \emph{jild}.) The chest? (\textbf{\ur{سینہ}}, \emph{sīnā}.) Bitter? (\textbf{\ur{کڑوا}}, \emph{kaṛvā}.) Sour? (\textbf{\ur{کھٹا}}, \emph{khaṭṭā}.) Salty? (\textbf{\ur{نمکین}}, \emph{namkīn}.) Fast? (\textbf{\ur{تیز}}, \emph{tez}.) Slow? (\textbf{\ur{دھیما}}, \emph{dhīmā}.) Dirty? (\textbf{\ur{گندا}}, \emph{gandā}.) Rich? (\textbf{\ur{امیر}}, \emph{amīr}.) True; the truth? (\textbf{\ur{سچ}}, \emph{sach}.) Strong? (\textbf{\ur{مضبوط}}, \emph{mazbūt}.) Weak? (\textbf{\ur{کمزور}}, \emph{kamzor}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
